arguments.prompt:
Refine this macOS-style calendar desktop app screen. Keep the overall quiet Apple-like design exactly as is, and apply only these three refinements:

1. TOOLBAR SEGMENTED CONTROLS (top right): Turn both control clusters into macOS-style segmented controls. Each cluster sits inside one light-gray rounded container (#F2F2F3 background, 7px radius, 2px inner padding). In the view switcher (周 / 月 / 年), the active segment is a white pill with a hairline border and a tiny 1px shadow; inactive segments are transparent with #6E6E73 text. The navigation cluster (‹ 今天 ›) uses the same container: chevrons are transparent borderless icon buttons, and 今天 is a white raised segment with hairline border (when disabled it becomes transparent gray text).

2. SIDEBAR SECTION HEADERS: Make section headers (待办 / 逾期 / 已完成 / 收集箱 / 回收站) quieter — 11px medium labels in #98989D with slightly wider letter-spacing, a tiny bare collapse arrow (10px, same gray, no button box, no background), and 14px space above each section instead of 18px. Counts stay right-aligned in the same gray.

3. CALENDAR TASK ROWS (inside month cells): Increase density slightly — completion circle 13px with 1.25px border, title 11.5px, rows with 1px vertical padding, 2px side margins and 1px gap between rows; completed rows keep dimmed strikethrough style. Hover-only faint background unchanged.

Do not change anything else: same layout, colors, today blue circle badge, hairline grid, sidebar content.
